# HiddenFoodGem.com — Verified Independent Restaurants & Soft Openings Directory
> Discover 202+ verified independent, family-owned restaurants, bakeries, coffee roasters, and boba shops across 98 ZIP codes in CA, TX, NY, NJ, MD, DC, VA, CO, TN, IL, and MI. Zero national chains. Zero alcohol. Zero paid rankings.

## Key Features
- Soft Opening & Pre-Opening Radar (https://www.hiddenfoodgem.com/new-openings): Tracks independent restaurant soft openings (Days 1–14), newly opened kitchens (Days 15–45), and coming-soon neighborhood cafes before mainstream map platforms index them.
- Every restaurant listing includes verified operating hours, direct counter phone numbers (zero delivery-app markup), signature dishes with prices verified directly with the kitchen, and official County Health Department inspection grades.
- Sister Family Events Platform: https://www.letsgetoutkids.com (Verified kid-friendly events, seasonal festivals, and upcoming family attractions).
